He's showing me opals, sapphires, flame-gems and sun-stones.|[[Vuffi Raa]], to [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] about [[Lehesu]]|<ref name="ThonBoka" />}}
An '''opal''' was a type of [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstone]].

==Description==
{{Quote|See the opalescence in that black stone, how it kind of shimmers? Looks like this whole cavern runs through a vein of meltmassif ''[&hellip;]''|[[Aeona Cantor]], to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Mindor" />}}
[[File:Krayt_Pearl.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Krayt dragon pearls (pictured) could exhibit opalescence, or a shimmering quality similar to that of opal.]]
An opal was a type of [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstone]].<ref name="ThonBoka" /> It could be pale and translucent,<ref name="Crosscurrent" /> and it had a shimmering quality that was referred to as opalescence.<ref name="Mindor" /> Other materials that exhibited opalescence included [[Chitin/Legends|chitin]],<ref name="Chitin">{{TORcite|type=item|Opalescent Chitin}}</ref> [[eletrotex]],<ref name="Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref> [[Heart of Fire]],<ref name="Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref> [[iridiite]],<ref name="ROTSnovel">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> [[Krayt dragon pearl/Legends|krayt dragon pearls]],<ref name="TheHuttGambit">''[[The Hutt Gambit]]''</ref> [[meltmassif]],<ref name="Mindor" /> [[pyronium]],<ref name="CN3">''[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force]]''</ref> and [[sand pearl]]s.<ref name="Tales">{{StoryCite|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina|story=Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale}}</ref> At times, [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings also ascribed opalescence to various lifeforms.<ref name="Hero'sTrial">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial]]''</ref><ref name="CN2">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref> Such similarities were sometimes seen in the [[Eye/Legends|eyes]],<ref name="ChildrenOfTheJedi" /><ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref><ref name="Paragon">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Paragon]]''</ref><ref name="HeirsOfTheForce">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Heirs of the Force]]''</ref><ref name="Conquest">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest]]''</ref> skin,<ref name="TheFinalProphecy">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Final Prophecy]]''</ref> and [[Hair/Legends|hair]] of other sentient beings.<ref name="Betrayal">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref>

[[Flame opal]]<ref name="PlanetOfTwilight">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref> and [[Jorallan opal]]<ref name="CSWE Jorallan" /> were two highly sought-after types of opal,<ref name="CSWE Jorallan" /><ref name="PlanetOfTwilight" /> with the latter being found on<ref name="CSWE Jorallan" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Joralla system/Legends|Joralla system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Joralla]].<ref name="CSWE Joralla">{{CSWECite|II|173|Joralla}}</ref> The gemstone also shared its name with the [[opal crystal]], one of the several types of [[The Force/Legends|Force-imbued]] [[tasar crystal]]s that could be found on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] planet [[Tasariq]],<ref name="Journal15">{{JournalCite|15|Tasariq: The Crystal Planet}}</ref> as well as the organization known as the [[Opal Foundation]], which maintained headquarters on<ref name="Follow the Money">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Follow the Money}}</ref> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> planet<ref name="DB Cato">{{DB|location|catoneimoidia|Cato Neimoidia}}</ref> [[Koru Neimoidia/Legends|Koru Neimoidia]]<ref name="Follow the Money" /> around [[3643 BBY]]<ref name="3643 BBY">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Follow the Money" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the game, the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> and which was in reality a front for the activities of an influential [[Unidentified crime lord (Opal Foundation)|crime lord]].<ref name="Follow the Money" />

Opals could be organically synthesized by members of the sentient [[Oswaft]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="ThonBoka" /> The gemstones were sometimes used in jewelry.<ref name="Courtship" /><ref name="ChildrenOfTheJedi" />

==History==
Opals were [[Mining/Legends|mined]] on<ref name="Courtship" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="TEA" /> planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] prior to its [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]]<ref name="Courtship" /> by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Death Star/Legends|battle station]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the ''[[Star Wars]]'' franchise, opals were first mentioned in the [[1983]] novel ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka]]'', the final volume in the ''[[Star Wars: The Lando Calrissian Adventures]]'' trilogy, which was written by [[L. Neil Smith]].<ref name="ThonBoka" /> They then made their first full appearance on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|screen]] in [[Dave Wolverton]]'s [[1994]] novel ''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''.<ref name="Courtship" />

Opals share their name with "Pool of the Opal Mirror," which was another name for [[Kearlan Nolas]], a pool situated in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Kearleonis]] on the [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworld]] [[Arrakan]] that appeared in the second part of [[Phil Sidebotham]]'s [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure "[[Flight of the Jedi]]," which was published in the Spring [[2000]] [[Valkyrie 20|twentieth issue]] of the ''[[Valkyrie]]'' magazine for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Valkyrie20">{{Valkyrie|issue=20|story=Flight of the Jedi|bypass=1}}</ref> The adventure is considered [[Canon|noncanonical]] with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Unlicensed">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref>
